name: Carrillo Law Firm, LLP

offices.label: The Carrillo Law Firm
offices.address: 1499 Huntington Dr #402, South Pasadena, CA 91030, USA

about: Carrillo Law Firm, LLP is a personal injury firm with a single office in South Pasadena.

The firm states that the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 6 of 16 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 10 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, incomplete: an adverse namesake we cannot resolve
G2.evidence: No disciplinary record is held against any of the 6 attorneys we identified. J. Miguel Flores could not be told apart from 8 namesakes, one of whom is not eligible to practise. Held open.
G2.unresolvable: A namesake carries an adverse status and the register holds no field that would tell the two people apart

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 7 named attorneys published, and 9 more people in roles the firm states are not a lawyer's.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 146 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2014-02-07, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

score.verdict: 3 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar B (4/15).
